name: io.github.flow-steward/pinecone-assistant
title: Pinecone Assistant
description: Retrieve grounded context from the documents uploaded to one of your Pinecone Assistants.

instance_host.description: The assistant's Host value from the Pinecone console (Assistants > your assistant), without https://. (for example: prod-1-data.ke.pinecone.io)

assistant_name.description: Name of the Pinecone Assistant, as shown in the console. (for example: support-docs)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Pinecone API key from the Pinecone console (API keys) for the project that owns the assistant. Enter it as: Bearer <value>
